about_heading: Cosmetic and alignment work in one practice
about_body:
Dr. Grisel Martos owns My Smile Miami, a Miami practice built around veneers, Invisalign, implants and Fotona laser treatment.

She holds Blue Diamond Plus status with Invisalign, and cosmetic, alignment and implant work is planned in the same place rather than split across referrals, so one plan carries a case from first consultation to finished result.
